Ashley: Spike observed on canary (vm-quant1) — ~3-4% p95 regression on generate.v1. Kernel selection flipped to aten_fused for a subset and KV-cache miss rate spiked. Collecting traces + token-breakdown metrics. Sample request_id: req_0a7b9e. Logs below.

Mateo: Which route exactly? generate.v1 or something else? Any sample request_id is perfect.

Ashley: route=generate.v1. req=req_0a7b9e. Paste of runtime log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:23Z] trace_id=tr_55ef kernel=aten_fused seq_len=48 kv_cache_hit=false request_id=req_0a7b9e token_latency_ms=12 kv_lookup_ms=3 kernel_ms=8 io_ms=1
[2026-03-15T12:01:23Z] span=token_gen span_id=span_9b token_idx=0
```

Priya: I ran a profiling sweep yesterday and saw the heuristic flip when seq_len < 64 — switching to aten_fused seemed cheaper on paper but it increases kernel_ms for our quant path. Also noticed KV miss storms when concurrent warmups hit the same shard. Pushing perf traces to Datadog: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/runtime/kernel-kv

Jordan: We currently tag the top-level request with request_id, but per-token spans don't carry request_id. That prevents direct SQL joins between token-level spans and metrics shards. We need to emit request_id on tokenizer/kernel spans.

Mateo: Agreed. Quick fix: add request_id tag to token and kernel spans in runtime instrumenter. Minimal risk, big win for correlation. I'll open a PR now.

deploy-bot: deploy/canary vm-quant1 started by @mateo at 2026-03-15T12:07:50Z :rocket:

Jordan: For immediate triage you can run this query to find traces for the sample request_id:
```sql
SELECT trace_id FROM token_spans WHERE tags.request_id = 'req_0a7b9e' LIMIT 1;
```
and then pull the full token span list.

Ashley: Per-route KPIs — generate.v1 p95 up ~3.8%, tokens/s down ~7% on canary. Other routes (embeddings) unchanged. Hypothesis: KV miss causes smaller effective batch sizes -> batching heuristics misfire.

Priya: I propose a new dashboard panel: "request-level token breakdown" with metrics: total_tokens, kernel_ms, kv_lookup_ms, io_ms, batch_wait_ms. Panel should be linkable to trace (trace_id) and support drilling by model_variant and seq_len bucket.

Mateo: PR #432 opened: runtime: emit request_id on token/kernel spans + add dashboard panels. Testing locally with stress harness. Will attach screenshots to PR.

Jordan: If the PR lands we can backfill correlations for the last 24h by joining metrics and traces on request_id. That will show whether this is a transient canary fluke or systemic.

Ashley: Good plan. If next canary deploy causes >5% p95 regression I'll pause the rollout. Keep me posted. :warning:
